The current document session owns the repository instance and fetcher. AnytypeTorahNotesService reads current origin objectId/spaceId association data, then filters actual Note metadata by the exact selected ID; no synthetic Note provider is used.

Repository notes cache/in-flight work uses selection.id within that instance. Add/unlink/Retry use original invalidation. This source trace does not establish fresh cold-reopen data, external-change freshness, actual account/Space isolation or complete joins of existing unstructured work.
